title: Frostpunk
shortDescription: Frostpunk helps define a Nintendo Switch survival path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Sets a direct-reference survival marker within the Nintendo Switch catalog.
Separates the GameAtlas catalog method from the external factual reference.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Documented for the Nintendo Switch survival discovery path using a Wikidata-listed catalog relationship; this remains source-aware discovery without copied review text.
